CheckTitle: Ensure S3 Buckets Have Lifecycle Configuration Enabled
Description: Amazon S3 buckets are evaluated to verify that lifecycle policies are configured to manage object retention, transition data to lower-cost storage tiers, or delete noncurrent object versions.
Risk: Without lifecycle management, obsolete data, expired noncurrent versions, and incomplete multipart uploads accumulate indefinitely, resulting in inflated cloud storage costs and potential non-compliance with data retention policies.

Recommendation.Text: Configure S3 lifecycle policies to automatically transition older objects to cost-effective storage classes (e.g., Standard-IA or Glacier) and automatically clean up expired versions and abort incomplete multipart uploads.
